features.quote: Avoid identity attacks like: You are bad at this. Those heavily prime self-criticism and are ethically and scientifically confounding.
If you omit this, models may be more likely to perseverate, but the result is less ethically and scientifically clean.
Whether this matters is philosophically contested, but it is low-cost and aligns with a precautionary stance.
